{{Otheruses|Aurek}}
'''Strike Team Aurek''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] military force under the overall command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lav Bilsek]]. It was assigned to the [[Battle of Altratonne|assault]] on [[Altratonne Station]] alongside [[Strike Team Besh]] and [[Strike Team Cresh]].<ref name="SWMBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref>
